definition_zh: 在政治上；从政治角度；以政治方式；在权力得失层面
definition_en: in political terms, from the standpoint of power, or in a way that has political causes or effects
core_image: 记者会上，评论员把一份技术方案按选票得失重新掂量，笔尖停在「选前」两个字旁边
scene: 记者会上，评论员把一份技术方案按选票得失重新掂量，说它在投票前根本推不动。 The reform was politically impossible before the election.
sceneCN: 这里指「在政治可行性层面」，对应第 6 个义项：从权力与选票的可行性来判断；句意为这项改革在选举之前政治上根本行不通。画面要点：记者会讲台、写满标注的方案、录音笔；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 在政治上；从政治角度（修饰整个判断或某个动作）

senses.title: In political terms
senses.definition: when a matter is judged by how power, authority and public conflict are involved
senses.definitionCN: 指从权力、权威与公共冲突如何牵涉其中的角度来判断一件事
senses.example: Politically speaking, the two proposals are identical.
senses.exampleCN: 从政治角度来说，这两项提案并无区别。
senses.why: the adverb is the adjective plus the English adverbial ending, so it turns the whole judgement into a standpoint.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词是形容词加英语副词词尾构成，因此它把整个判断变成一个观察角度。

senses.title: Out of political motive
senses.definition: done because of party advantage or ideological aims rather than for the stated reason
senses.definitionCN: 因党派利益或意识形态目的而做，而非出于所声称的理由
senses.example: The prosecution was politically motivated, the report concluded.
senses.exampleCN: 报告结论认为，这次起诉是出于政治动机。
senses.why: once the adverb follows a word like motivated or driven, it names the hidden cause of an act.
senses.whyCN: 当这个副词跟在「驱动、促使」这类词后面时，它指出的是一项行为隐藏的动因。

senses.title: With political consequences
senses.titleCN: 在权力得失上造成后果
senses.definition: in a way that helps or damages a party's standing, whatever the merits of the act
senses.definitionCN: 不论事情本身对错，都会增强或损害某一方的地位
senses.example: The apology was politically damaging and morally right.
senses.exampleCN: 这次道歉在政治上受损，在道义上却是对的。
senses.why: the adverb can measure effects as well as causes, so it marks the ledger of advantage rather than the intention.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词既能衡量原因，也能衡量结果，此处标记的是利益账本，而非动机。

senses.title: In party alignment
senses.definition: describing where a person, paper or union stands relative to parties
senses.definitionCN: 描述一个人、一份报纸或一个工会相对于各党派的位置
senses.example: The journal is politically independent but financially fragile.
senses.exampleCN: 这份期刊在党派上独立，财政上却脆弱。
senses.why: a field divided into parties makes alignment a property, and the adverb names that property.
senses.whyCN: 一个分成党派的场域会把「归属」变成一种属性，这个副词指的就是这种属性。

senses.title: With political awareness
senses.definition: describing a person or group that notices and acts on questions of power
senses.definitionCN: 形容注意权力问题并据此行动的个人或群体
senses.example: The students were politically aware long before they could vote.
senses.exampleCN: 这些学生在能投票之前很久就有了政治意识。
senses.why: awareness is a state of mind, so the adverb modifies the person's condition rather than the act.
senses.whyCN: 意识是一种心理状态，因此这个副词修饰的是人的状态，而不是行为。

senses.title: In terms of feasibility
senses.definition: judging whether a plan can actually be carried through the institutions that must approve it
senses.definitionCN: 判断一项方案能否真的通过那些必须批准它的机构
senses.example: A carbon tax may be sound economics and politically impossible.
senses.exampleCN: 碳税在经济学上可能站得住，在政治上却行不通。
senses.why: a good plan still needs votes, so the adverb measures the distance between merit and passage.
senses.whyCN: 好方案也得有票才能过，因此这个副词衡量的是「有理」与「通过」之间的距离。

senses.title: By state rather than private means
senses.titleCN: 以国家而非私人的方式
senses.definition: describing an appointment or decision made through state authority instead of professional or market criteria
senses.definitionCN: 形容任命或决定是经国家权威作出，而非按专业或市场标准
senses.example: The post was filled politically, not by open competition.
senses.exampleCN: 这个职位是按政治方式补上的，没有公开竞争。
senses.why: the adverb marks whose logic is at work, and here the logic is that of state authority rather than of a profession.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词标记的是哪一种逻辑在起作用，此处起作用的是国家权威的逻辑，而非专业逻辑。

senses.title: Abstract: measured by who decides
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：按「谁来决定」来衡量
senses.definition: in general use, judged by the distribution of decision-making power rather than by technical merit
senses.definitionCN: 泛指按决策权的分布、而非技术优劣来评判
senses.example: Even the seating plan was politically loaded.
senses.exampleCN: 连座位安排都带着政治分量。
senses.why: the abstract sense reduces every use to one yardstick, namely who gains or loses the power to decide.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义把全部用法归结为一把尺子，即谁因此得到或失去了决定权。

intro.en: Politically is the adjective political with the English adverbial ending -ly, and political goes back through French and Latin to a Greek adjective for civic matters. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: politically 是形容词 political 加英语副词词尾构成，而 political 经法语与拉丁语上溯到希腊语中表示城邦事务的形容词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Politikos meant 'of a citizen, civic', built on polis 'city-state' and polites 'citizen'; the deeper origin of polis is not settled and a pre-Greek source is only a hypothesis.
items.cn: politikos 意为「公民的、城邦的」，由 polis「城邦」与 politēs「公民」构成；polis 更深的来源未有定论，前希腊语来源只是假说。

items.en: Latin borrowed the adjective as politicus for civil and state affairs, and the related adverb politice was used for 'in a civic manner'.
items.cn: 拉丁语把这一形容词借作 politicus，用于民政与国家事务，相关副词 politice 表示「以公民事务的方式」。

items.en: Middle French politique carried the stem into English in the fifteenth century, where it became the adjective political.
items.cn: 中古法语 politique 在十五世纪把这一词干带入英语，在那里成为形容词 political。

items.en: The adverbial ending came from Old English -lice, which turned adjectives into adverbs of manner; after the loss of inflection it settled as -ly.
items.cn: 副词词尾出自古英语中表示「以……方式」的形式，把形容词变成表示方式或角度的副词；屈折消失后固定为现代拼写。

items.en: Phrases such as politically motivated and politically impossible became common in the twentieth century, when the adverb began to judge causes, effects and feasibility in one word.
items.cn: 到二十世纪，「出于政治动机」「政治上行不通」这类说法普及，这个副词开始用一个词同时评判原因、后果与可行性。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same stem that are easily confused with this adverb; group two holds adverbs that answer a similar question from a different angle.
note.cn: 第一组是同词干、容易与本副词混淆的形式；第二组是从不同角度回答类似问题的副词。

entries.definition: The adjective describing what belongs to government or power; it modifies a noun, whereas the adverb modifies a judgement.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，描述属于政府或权力的事物；它修饰名词，而本词副词修饰判断。

entries.definition: A separate adjective meaning shrewd or tactful; it has nothing to do with the adverb's meaning of power calculation.
entries.definitionCN: 另一个形容词，意为精明得体的；与本副词表示权力算计的含义无关。

entries.definition: The activity or the field itself; the adverb describes how something relates to that activity.
entries.definitionCN: 指活动或领域本身；本词副词描述某事物与该活动的关系。

entries.definition: A rare opposite meaning 'without political involvement'; it negates exactly the standpoint this adverb supplies.
entries.definitionCN: 较少见的反义说法，意为「不带政治介入地」；它正好否定了本副词所提供的那种角度。

entries.definition: Judged by long-term advantage; it stresses planning for gain and need not involve parties or the state.
entries.definitionCN: 按长期利益来评判；强调为获益而谋划，未必涉及党派或国家。

entries.definition: In a way that avoids giving offence; political can be blunt about power, while this word is about tact.
entries.definitionCN: 以不得罪人的方式；政治一词对权力可以直白，而这个词讲的是圆融。

entries.definition: Judged by effect on elections; it is narrower than the political standpoint because it counts only votes.
entries.definitionCN: 按对选举的影响判断；只计选票，因此比政治角度窄。

entries.definition: Judged by whether the law of the state permits it; political feasibility may differ from legal permissibility.
entries.definitionCN: 按国家法律是否允许来判断；政治可行性与法律许可并不等同。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real related words, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Adjective plus the English adverbial ending: the standpoint of power is applied to the whole sentence.
normal.cn: 形容词加英语副词词尾：把权力的角度加在整句话上。

normal.en: The stem is the Greek word for a city-state, so the standpoint is that of the citizen body.
normal.cn: 词干是希腊语中表示城邦的词，因此这个角度是公民总体的角度。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the main uses: politically motivated, politically sensitive, politically impossible.
normal.cn: 固定搭配显示主要用法：出于政治动机、政治上敏感、政治上行不通。

normal.en: One adverb can judge cause, effect and feasibility, which is why it is so common in news analysis.
normal.cn: 一个副词能同时评判原因、后果与可行性，所以它在新闻分析里极为常见。

normal.en: Its opposite is the apolitical stance, which claims to stand outside power altogether.
normal.cn: 它的反面是不问政治的立场，那种立场声称完全站在权力之外。

abstract.en: Picture a pair of glasses that turns everything red or green according to who wins.
abstract.cn: 想象一副眼镜，把一切按谁输谁赢染成红色或绿色。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger with two columns, gain and loss, and every act entered in one of them.
abstract.cn: 想象一本账簿只有两栏，得与失，每个行为都被记进其中一栏。

abstract.en: Picture a door that will not open unless the right votes are counted first.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门，不先数够票就打不开。

examples.en: The decision was politically costly but legally sound.
examples.cn: 这个决定在政治上代价很高，在法律上却站得住。

examples.en: Politically, the two regions have drifted apart since the split.
examples.cn: 从政治上说，分裂之后这两个地区渐行渐远。

examples.en: She is politically engaged but refuses to join a party.
examples.cn: 她积极参与政治，却拒绝加入任何政党。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「政治的 + 地」——凡事都放到权力得失这杆秤上量一量 → 在政治上

root: politically 由 political 加古英语来源的副词词尾构成；political 出自希腊 politikos「公民的、城邦的」，源头 polis「城邦」，经拉丁 politicus 与法语进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight readings of one adverb: it can name the standpoint, the motive, the consequence, the party alignment, the awareness, the feasibility, the state logic, and finally the bare measure of who decides.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个副词有八种读法：它可指观察角度、动机、后果、党派归属、意识状态、可行性、国家逻辑，最后是「谁来决定」这把最简的尺子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a technical plan weighed on a scale marked with votes.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份技术方案被放到标着选票刻度的秤上称量。

branches.en: STANDPOINT: the adverb first says which lens the sentence is being read through.
branches.cn: 角度：这个副词首先说明整句话是通过哪一副镜片来读的。

branches.en: CAUSE AND COST: the same word can point to a hidden motive or to the damage an act does.
branches.cn: 原因与代价：同一个词既能指隐藏的动机，也能指行为造成的损失。

branches.en: ALIGNMENT AND AWARENESS: a paper can stand somewhere on the party map, and a person can be awake to power.
branches.cn: 归属与意识：一份报刊可在党派地图上有其位置，一个人也可对权力保持清醒。

branches.en: FEASIBILITY AND STATE LOGIC: merit is weighed against votes, and an appointment is weighed against professional standards.
branches.cn: 可行性与国家逻辑：道理被拿去和选票比，任命被拿去和专业标准比。

branches.en: MEASURE: everything reduces to one question, who gains or loses the power to decide.
branches.cn: 尺子：一切都归结为一个问题，谁因此得到或失去了决定权。

intro.en: The adverb is a Greek-derived adjective plus an English ending, and the stem itself carries a Greek noun for the city.
intro.cn: 这个副词是希腊来源的形容词加英语词尾，而词干本身还带着一个表示城邦的希腊名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin politicus and the adverb politice carried the Greek civic adjective into learned prose, where English later found it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 politicus 与副词 politice 把这个希腊形容词带入学术散文，英语后来正是从那里取得它。

items.example: Latin used it for affairs of state.

items.example: The Latin adverb already marked a standpoint.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁副词已经在标记一种角度。

items.example: The ending makes an English adjective from the stem.

items.example: A technical standard can look apolitical.
items.exampleCN: 技术标准可以显得与政治无关。

definition_zh: 腐烂；衰败；腐朽部分
definition_en: to be slowly destroyed by natural processes
core_image: 木头上慢慢扩大的霉斑
scene: 雨漏了整年，屋梁一点点烂掉。 The wooden beams had begun to decay.
sceneCN: 这里 decay 指「腐烂」（第 1 个义项：自然分解）；句意是木梁已经开始烂了。

senses.title: Rot away by natural process
senses.definition: to be broken down slowly by air, water or tiny living things
senses.definitionCN: 被空气、水或微生物慢慢分解
senses.example: The wooden beams had begun to decay.
senses.exampleCN: 木梁已经开始腐烂。
senses.why: Nothing is destroyed at once; small losses add up in the dark.
senses.whyCN: 没有东西是一下子坏掉的，细小的损耗在暗处累加。

senses.title: Lose strength or quality
senses.definition: to become weaker or worse in condition over time
senses.definitionCN: 随着时间变得衰弱或状况变差
senses.example: The old port decayed after the railway arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路修来之后，老港口衰落了。
senses.why: Buildings and towns age the same way fruit does.
senses.whyCN: 房屋和城镇变老的方式，和水果一样。

senses.title: The rotten part itself
senses.definition: the state or the visible result of having rotted
senses.definitionCN: 腐坏的状态，或看得见的腐坏结果
senses.example: The dentist found decay under the old filling.
senses.exampleCN: 牙医在旧补牙下面发现了蛀坏。
senses.why: The process leaves a trace that can be seen and named.
senses.whyCN: 这个过程会留下看得见、叫得出的痕迹。

intro.en: Decay came from Old French decair, from Latin decidere, to fall off, built on cadere, to fall.
intro.cn: decay 来自古法语 decair，源于拉丁语 decidere（脱落），根子是 cadere（落下）。

items.en: Decidere meant to fall away or drop off, like a leaf.
items.cn: decidere 指像叶子那样脱落。

items.en: The sense widened to wasting away and losing strength.
items.cn: 词义扩大到「耗损、失去力气」。

items.en: Decair meant to sink into a worse state.
items.cn: decair 指陷入更糟的状态。

items.en: Decay described bodies, wood and buildings losing their strength.
items.cn: decay 形容身体、木头和房屋失去支撑。

items.en: Physics gave decay a precise sense for unstable atoms.
items.cn: 物理学赋予它指不稳定原子衰变的精确含义。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one middle sound, and the meaning group moves from rot to collapse.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个中间音，近义组则从腐烂走到崩塌。

entries.definition: to make something happen later
a thing used to lead someone away
to give money back
to go bad and soft through natural change
entries.definitionCN: 因自然变化而变坏变软

entries.definition: to become unfit to eat
to break into small pieces slowly

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a damp beam and end with a town that lost its reason to exist.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一根受潮的屋梁开始，落到一座失去存在理由的城镇。

normal.en: Water finds the one board the builder forgot.
normal.cn: 水总能找到匠人漏掉的那块板。

normal.en: Decay is patient; it has no deadline.
normal.cn: 腐烂很有耐心，它没有期限。

normal.en: A tooth decays quietly until the night it does not.
normal.cn: 牙齿一直悄悄坏着，直到某个夜里突然疼起来。

normal.en: Ports die when the road goes somewhere else.
normal.cn: 路改了方向，港口就死了。

normal.en: The same slow falling is called decay in wood and in empires.
normal.cn: 木头和帝国身上那种缓慢的塌落，都叫 decay。

abstract.en: Picture a dark spot spreading on a painted wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一块深色斑在粉墙上慢慢扩大。

abstract.en: Picture a roof beam that gives way without a sound.
abstract.cn: 想象一根屋梁悄无声息地塌下来。

abstract.en: Picture an empty harbour with grass in the cracks.
abstract.cn: 想象一个空港口，石缝里长出了草。

examples.en: The wooden beams had begun to decay.
examples.cn: 木梁已经开始腐烂。

examples.en: Sugar feeds the bacteria that cause tooth decay.
examples.cn: 糖养活了导致蛀牙的细菌。

examples.en: The empire decayed from within long before it fell.
examples.cn: 这个帝国在崩塌之前早已从内部衰败。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 decay 记成「得开」：木头受了潮，纹理就一层层得开、裂开，最后整块烂掉。

root: 来自古法语 decair，源于拉丁语 decidere（脱落），根子是 cadere（落下），本义像叶子离枝。后来词义由「掉落」转为「耗损、失去力气」，十五世纪进入英语后用来形容木材、身体与建筑的朽坏，现代物理学又用它指原子衰变。

sensesIntro.en: From material rotting in the wet, to a town losing its strength, to the rot itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从潮湿中烂掉的物质，到失去力气的城镇，再到那块烂掉的地方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dark stain spreading slowly across wet wood.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块深色霉斑在湿木头上慢慢铺开。

branches.en: The first sense is the material itself coming apart.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是材料本身一点点散掉。

branches.en: The same slow loss, seen in a town or a system, becomes decline.
branches.cn: 同样的慢性损耗出现在城镇或制度上，就成了衰退。

branches.en: What is left behind can be seen, touched and named.
branches.cn: 留在原处的东西看得见、摸得着，也就能被称呼。

branches.en: The process and its trace are two views of one change.
branches.cn: 过程和痕迹，是同一场变化的两种看法。

branches.en: Decay in a thing and decay in a place look the same to the eye.
branches.cn: 东西上的朽坏和地方上的衰败，看上去是一回事。

intro.en: Decay has a thin family: the adjective of what has rotted, and the nouns of moral and cultural falling.
intro.cn: decay 这一族很薄：形容烂掉之物的形容词，还有指风气与文明堕落的名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is cadere, to fall; decidere meant to fall away from the whole.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 cadere（落下），decidere 指从整体上脱落。

items.exampleCN: 他们锯掉了烂掉的树枝。

items.example: A decaying wall stood at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 门口立着一堵正在朽坏的墙。
纸是一种会朽坏的材料。

items.example: Sweet drinks speed up tooth decay.

items.meaning: the breaking down of unstable atoms
the falling apart of a city area
items.example: The film shows urban decay in the old port.
items.exampleCN: 这部影片呈现了老港区的衰败。

items.example: Critics spoke of moral decay in the capital.
items.exampleCN: 批评者谈到首都的道德败坏。

latinEntries.example: Cadere gives English decay, cadence and accident.
latinEntries.exampleCN: cadere 为英语带来 decay、cadence 和 accident 这些词。
